description_en: Queries the status of the CloudMonitor agent on simple application servers
description_zh: 查询轻量应用服务器云监控插件的状态
name: DescribeCloudMonitorAgentStatuses

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application servers. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the simple application servers. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 simple application server IDs. Separate multiple server IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: instance_ids

InstanceStatusList.description_en: Indicates whether the Cloud Monitor agent was automatically installed on the simple application server

items.description_en: Indicates whether the Cloud Monitor agent was automatically installed on the simple application server

AutoInstall.description_en:
Indicates whether the Cloud Monitor agent was automatically installed on the simple application server. Valid values:

true

false
AutoInstall.description_zh:
是否自动安装云监控插件。取值：

true。

false

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the simple application server

Status.description_en:
The running status of the Cloud Monitoring plug-in. Possible values are:

running: Cloud Monitoring plug-in running.

stopped: Cloud Monitoring plug-in stopped.

installing: Cloud Monitoring plug-in installing.

install_faild: Cloud Monitoring plug-in installation failed.

abnormal: Cloud Monitoring plug-in installation abnormal.

not_installed: Cloud Monitoring plug-in not installed
Status.description_zh:
插件的运行状态。取值：

running：运行中。
stopped：已停止。
installing：安装中。
install_faild：安装失败。
abnormal：安装异常。
not_installed：未安装
